_what: The capture proxy a person points a program at to see what it sends (computer/capture-proxy.mjs). It listens on 127.0.0.1 only. `tunnel_hosts` are sites passed through untouched (never opened with the capture certificate); `only_hosts`, when not empty, limits capture to those domains and tunnels the rest. `redact_headers` are header names whose values are never kept. `body_bytes` bounds what is kept of each body. `captures_file` (under the home folder) is where the separate proxy process writes one JSON line per exchange.

words.bad_target: The proxy was asked for {target}, which is not a host and port.
